assertions.text: Output is a valid YAML document
The trigger is declared at the pipeline root — a sensors: block for external-state polling, or trigger_events: for reacting to another Orchestra pipeline's completion — not modeled as a pipeline task
Each sensor declares at least one check under its checks: block
Each sensor's timeout_mins stays below its cron interval rather than exceeding it
Each sensor's frequency_secs (when set) falls within Orchestra's valid 60-600 second polling range
